items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Demonstrated experience in using computer application software including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and web based applications.
Demonstrated experience working with an online web content management system, basic knowledge or website design and development.
Demonstrated experience working in an academic environment.
Demonstrated experience using GoogleDrive, GoogleCalendar, GoogleDocs, GoogleSheets, and GoogleForms.
2-4 years of related experience
Demonstrated experience with processing travel reimbursements and purchasing.

Drafts and executes purchase orders, utilizing standard terms and conditions for materials, supplies, equipment, and services. Drafts Request for Quotations (RFQs) including specifications and terms and conditions. (30% time)

Support of departmental business operations, including related procurement and business transactions, which includes but is not limited to processing complex travel, reimbursements, direct payments, entertainment requests, projects including student and faculty recruitment coordination, relocations, submission of recharges and work orders for UCR campus services (catering, facilities, communications, media, etc.), event and travel coordination, and other operational needs as requested. (25% time)

Regularly communicates with organization's customers, reduces risk to the University by ensuring departmental compliance with procurement policy, and works in conjunction with end-users to develop specifications for RFQs. (20% time)

Review and reconcile purchase orders that have posted to general ledger and review encumbrance balance report to reconcile open encumbrances for release and appropriateness. In conjunction with leadership team, serve as liaison with Accounts Payable. Take lead on researching issues on large dollar items. Pre-reviews and reconciles assigned areas of monthly general ledgers and reports for the department. (10% time)
Negotiates with suppliers for lower prices and better terms and helps resolve supplier performance issues. (5% time)
Interprets and applies basic University policies and procedures. (5% time)
Other duties as assigned, including but not limited to serving as the primary backup for front desk operations, key/card access assistance, etc... (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly

Analytical skills necessary to evaluate the quality and cost effectiveness of purchasing options.
Understands financial systems (such as Oracle, PeopleSoft, SAP, Banner, etc.).
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Some knowledge of the organization's departments and operations required in order to meet their procurement needs.
Ability to read and interpret terms and conditions of basic contracts.
Working knowledge of University of California, Riverside policies and procedures related to instruction and graduate programs.
Working level of proficiency in the use of standard spreadsheet and word processing software.
Knowledge of and experience using UCR's online systems.
Demonstrated ability to organize and set priorities. Respond to the needs of other entities and a variety of individuals in a cooperative and professional manner.
Knowledge of UC System-wide and Campus Purchasing Policies and procedures.
Demonstrated willingness to handle a heavy workload and continue to provide excellent customer service.
Skills to provide coaching and mentoring to support staff.
Ability to research and analyze information to formulate and implement solutions to problems.
Ability to function effectively as a member of a team.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities.
Demonstrated accuracy and attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, work on multiple projects and complete assignments on time.
